newsitem.title: USA: SunGard Data unit to acquire ClearVision.
newsitem.headline: SunGard Data unit to acquire ClearVision.

text.p: SunGard Futures Systems, a subsidiary of SunGard Data Systems Inc, said Tuesday it agreed in principle to acquire the rights to the ClearVision product, a clearing automation software for the futures and options industry.
Alexandre Fusiller and Patrick Lievre, creators of ClearVision, are joining SunGard in senior management positions.

Terms were not disclosed. The acquisition, structured as a lump-sum cash transaction plus performance-based incentives, is expected to close March 31 and should not have a material impact on SunGard's 1997 financial results.
